correctness.rationale: The graph is the 21-edge Fano incidence Heawood graph, with faces exactly the edge subsets extendible to seven-edge perfect matchings, not the ordinary matching complex. Independent construction from the line blocks i,i+1,i+3 (mod 7) enumerated exactly 24 perfect matchings and all 2201 nonempty faces, f=(21,168,560,756,504,168,24). The specified deterministic lower-to-upper face toggle matching has 1092 disjoint pairs and exactly one critical 0-face and sixteen critical 2-faces. We independently reconstructed all 8736 nonempty Hasse inclusions, reversed exactly the matched edges and topologically sorted all 2201 vertices, confirming acyclicity exhaustively. Forman then yields a CW model with one 0-cell and sixteen 2-cells, no 1-cells, whose attaching maps are constant, hence an integral wedge of sixteen 2-spheres. This is exhaustive finite proof, not a heuristic mod-2 Betti count.

Its integral wedge homotopy contrasts sharply with the ordinary Heawood matching complex, and a complete finite Morse reduction provides reusable benchmark combinatorial topology.
